question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right back, Bob is playing left back, and Claire is playing left winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Claire and Alice trade positions. Finally, Bob and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) right back
(B) left back
(C) left winger
solution:
Position order: (Alice, Bob, Claire).
Initial: (right back, left back, left winger)
1. Bob ↔ Claire: (right back, left winger, left back)
2. Claire ↔ Alice: (left back, left winger, right back)
3. Bob ↔ Claire: (left back, right back, left winger)
Alice is playing left back, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
